group_of_six.rule: the highest-ranked Group of Six team in the final CFP rankings (it doesn't have to be a conference champion)

notre_dame.rule: Notre Dame gets a bid if it finishes in the top 12 of the final CFP rankings

at_large: the rest of the field, highest-ranked first
seeding: straight by CFP ranking; automatic qualifiers ranked outside the top 12 go in order at the bottom of the seeding

sources.says: 12 teams in 2026; automatic bids to the Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 champions; the highest-ranked Group of Six team in the final rankings (not necessarily a champion); Notre Dame in with a top-12 finish
CFP Management Committee keeps 12 teams for 2026; four power-conference champions get automatic bids; Notre Dame eligible for an automatic bid in the top 12; first-round games on campus
rankings on Tuesdays Nov. 3, 10, 17, 24 and Dec. 1; Selection Day Sunday, Dec. 6

4 automatic bids for the ACC, Big Ten, Big 12 and SEC champions; 1 for the highest-ranked team from the American, Conference USA, MAC, Mountain West, Pac-12 or Sun Belt; Notre Dame automatic if in the CFP top 12 on Selection Day (then 6 at-larges, else 7); seeded by the committee's final rankings; seeds 1-4 get byes, 5-12 play at the higher seed; automatic qualifiers outside the top 12 go at the bottom of the seeding; quarterfinals 1 vs 8/9, 2 vs 7/10, 3 vs 6/11, 4 vs 5/12; first round Dec. 18-19, 2026
